ops.title: v0.37.0: known-bad release, valid module version — do not delete the tag
ops.body:
## Verdict

**synckit v0.37.0 stays. Do NOT delete the tag v0.37.0 (1e69ed6).**

v0.37.0 is a known-bad **GitHub Release** but a perfectly valid **Go module
version**. Those are separate facts and only the second one matters to a
`go.mod` consumer — `go.sum` pins a module version by its immutable proxy
content, never a Release object.

## Why it has no Release object

The v0.37.0 release workflow run
(`gh run view 30800022549 --repo yasyf/synckit`) failed at goreleaser's
`linux_arm64_v8.0` build step:

```
build failed: exit status 1: package github.com/yasyf/synckit/cmd/synckitd
	imports github.com/yasyf/synckit/daemon
	imports github.com/yasyf/daemonkit/launchd: build constraints exclude all
	Go files in /home/runner/go/pkg/mod/github.com/yasyf/daemonkit@v0.21.2/launchd
	target=linux_arm64_v8.0
```

daemonkit is darwin-only as of v0.21 (see daemonkit AGENTS.md: "macOS only,
and structurally so" — no `_other.go` stubs, no `!darwin` tags, the module
does not compile off darwin). The v0.37.0 release workflow still cross-compiled
linux targets, so goreleaser's linux/arm64 leg failed and the release
publish step never ran — no GitHub Release exists for the tag, and none
partially exists either (`gh release view v0.37.0` → `release not found`).

**v0.37.1** (commit `5584762`, "release: drop the linux targets — daemonkit
v0.21 compiles only on macOS") is the fix, released successfully, and is
synckit's current `origin/main` tip. **v0.37.1 is the version to pin going
forward** for any new/updated dependency.

## Why v0.37.0 is not deletable

- Standing rule: tags are permanent; never recut or retag.
- `proxy.golang.org/github.com/yasyf/synckit/@v/v0.37.0.info` already
  returns 200 — the module proxy serves it immutably regardless of what
  happens to the GitHub tag or Release.
- Four fleet repos pin it today via `go.sum` hash records (verified
  2026-08-07):
  - `reposync` — direct dependency (go.mod:11); reposync's own main tip
    (`3e0b3e1`) *intentionally* introduces this pin.
  - `cookiesync` — direct dependency (go.mod:14)
  - `cc-present` — direct dependency (go.mod:14)
  - `cc-orchestrate` — indirect dependency (go.mod:62)

  All four share the same go.sum hash pair:
  `h1:qt/zlJ33TXtadINjt6nAnAMsYmt+R/ac0MSSkYUAau8=` /
  `go.mod h1:BC+m0fQlMX95tz223JGTn6Ds2naCjl4e9/vUFwONBkU=`.

  Deleting the tag would not remove those pins or invalidate the proxy's
  immutable copy, but would break `git describe`/local clone-from-tag
  workflows and violate the no-retag rule for no benefit.

## Bottom line

Do nothing to v0.37.0's tag or module availability. It is release-broken,
not module-broken. New/updated go.mod pins go to v0.37.1 or later; existing
v0.37.0 pins are safe to leave as-is (they resolve fine from the proxy) or
migrate to v0.37.1 at each repo's own convenience — not a synckit-side
action item.
